sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 negative: caller-supplied actuation_leg cannot force the AD path
sys_atf_test.description: A cloud-only object with a caller-forged actuation_leg of 'ad' must still route to the Graph leg and must still run the ELEVATE clause.

sys_atf_step.description: Forge actuation_leg='ad' on a cloud-only object; assert the derived leg wins.
An unclassifiable object must fail closed at clause route, not default to a leg.
